T-001.Title: Append the 4.5:1 light syntax palette to github-dark.css with failing-first two-engine evidence

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Before any write, on the fresh head: record SHA-256 digests of the byte-identical file set (mark-quicklook/Sources/Shared/MarkdownRenderer.swift, mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/PreviewProvider.swift, mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/style.css, mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/markdown-it.min.js, mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/highlight.min.js, mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/MarkPreview.entitlements) via shasum -a 256 into the change bundle, and produce failing-first evidence on the unchanged sources: the actual MarkdownRenderer.swift output (private Foundation-only console driver, packaged resources byte-copied) rendered in Chromium and WebKit under a light appearance shows the highlighted-string contrast failure on the light pre background while the dark appearance remains the positive control. Historical review numbers (1.4438:1 light, 11.2542:1 dark) are characterization only; this plan re-measures on the fresh head.

Append exactly the implementation-notes CSS block to the end of mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/github-dark.css: one new @media (prefers-color-scheme: light){...} branch containing the 13 group rules covering all 41 existing color-bearing selectors verbatim (selector text copied 1:1 from the existing dark rules), with foregrounds base/.hljs-subst #1f2328; keyword group #cf222e; title group #6f42c1; constant group #005cc5; string group #032f62; builtin group #953800; comment group #656d76; tag group #116329; emphasis/strong #1f2328; section #005cc5; bullet #735c0f; addition #116329 on background-color #f0fff4; deletion #b31d28 on background-color #ffeef0. Only color and background-color declarations appear in the new branch; no font, spacing, geometry, parsing or script change. The attribution header, resource name, bundle load order and every dark/default declaration stay byte-identical (append-only; a single newline separator; no new GRACE markup inside the packaged resource). No .hljs root class, theme engine, script bridge, dependency or additional resource is introduced.

Deterministic palette proof: every one of the 41 dark color-bearing selectors is covered exactly once by the 13 light groups; each group meets an unrounded WCAG contrast of at least 4.5:1 computed against its actually applicable background (#f6f8fa for base/keyword/title/constant/string/builtin/comment/tag/emphasis/section/bullet; the group's own #f0fff4/#ffeef0 token background for addition/deletion), with computed values compared against the approved spec palette table; representative Markdown-generated tokens are measured in the actual rendered document and any supplemental controlled selector spans used for full 41-selector coverage are labelled separately from real Markdown/highlight cases. Evidence retained: failing-first and after-override HTML, recipe, contrast computations and screenshots.

Two-engine appearance matrix on the actual Swift HTML after the override: Chromium and WebKit, light and dark, with a JavaScript block, a Python block, an unknown-language/plain block and an inline-code control. Light values follow the specified palette on the #f6f8fa pre background with all light target ratios at 4.5:1 or above before rounding; plain/inline controls stay readable; no page errors and no external resource requests occur; switching appearance preserves the exact code text, token classes and code geometry; dark control retains the original dark computed values.

T-002.Title: Add required fail-closed theme-light/theme-dark native fixture cases and extend the runner protocol

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/quicklook/PreviewBoundaryTests.swift adds exactly two required cases per the implementation notes: BoundaryCase("theme-light", ...) and BoundaryCase("theme-dark", ...) with a JavaScript block carrying real keyword/string/number/comment token spans plus an inline-code control. Each theme case forces the appearance only on the fixture's own provider WKWebView via NSAppearance(named: .aqua) or NSAppearance(named: .darkAqua) — never NSApplication.shared.appearance, never system appearance, no host/extension registration — waits bounded for matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)') to agree, and evaluates a dedicated theme script returning media matches, the pre background, computed token colors, code text length and code geometry. theme-light asserts the light media match, pre background rgb(246, 248, 250), computed colors equal to the specified light palette rgb values, an unrounded in-page contrast of at least 4.5:1 for every measured token, readable plain/inline controls, and that switching to the dark appearance preserves code text and geometry exactly. theme-dark asserts the dark media match (light media false), computed colors equal to the original dark palette values, and a dark contrast control of at least 4.5:1. Any mismatched color, media, sub-4.5:1 ratio, changed text/geometry or failed observation sets passed=false — never a skip. The shared snapshotScript, all 24 existing case definitions and checks stay unchanged; the native exit gate becomes exit(rows.count == 26 ...); file-local VERSION, MODULE_CONTRACT SCOPE and CHANGE_SUMMARY are synchronized (case count stated as twenty-six).

tools/check-quicklook.mjs extends REQUIRED_QUICKLOOK_CASES to exactly 26 entries by appending 'theme-light', 'theme-dark' after 'repeat-preview'. The fail-closed protocol mechanics are unchanged and now cover the theme cases: complete exact ID set (missing, duplicate or unknown case is QL_CASE_SET_INCOMPLETE), literal passed==true per case (anything else is QL_NATIVE_CASE_FAILED), independent zero observer requests, zero native exit code, unchanged-source and bundled-resource digests, and the unchanged 110-second whole-run deadline including the two additional provider cycles. Markers, receipt fields and output format are unchanged; file-local VERSION, MODULE_CONTRACT/MODULE_MAP and CHANGE_SUMMARY are synchronized. No skip, retry, budget raise or unsupported-host success path is added.

Native sensitivity proof: with the fixture and runner changes in place but the T-001 light branch temporarily removed (exact bytes restored afterwards and proven by digest), node tools/check-quicklook.mjs fails via QL_NATIVE_CASE_FAILED on theme-light — proving the native theme gate actually detects the palette it claims — and passes after restoration. The full failed receipt from the mutated run is retained.

Both new cases are mandatory elements of the native result protocol everywhere it is consumed: locally and in the hosted macos-15 quicklook-native job, which runs the same command on the exact head and therefore requires the complete 26-case set. No workflow file change is made; the hosted job keeps its required-gate role, inverses and budgets unchanged.

T-003.Title: Renderer runner unit completeness/failure controls and deterministic CSS palette coverage

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/renderer/quicklook-runner.test.js updates its pinned counts to the 26-case protocol — expect(validateNativeResult(nativeResult())).toBe(26) and expect(result.cases).toHaveLength(26) in the existing happy-path case — and pins the frozen required list exactly: the 24 existing boundary case IDs in their current order followed by 'theme-light', 'theme-dark' (toEqual on the full array). All 34 existing unit cases keep their assertions, doubles and structure; no skip, retry, timeout or floor change.

New fail-closed controls with expectations stated independently from the implementation: a result missing theme-dark is QL_CASE_SET_INCOMPLETE; a duplicated theme-light is QL_CASE_SET_INCOMPLETE; a theme case with passed=false, undefined, 'true' or 1 is QL_NATIVE_CASE_FAILED. These reuse the existing protocol error codes and add no new runner behavior.

New deterministic static palette control reading the packaged mark-quicklook/Sources/PreviewExtension/Resources/github-dark.css and style.css: exactly one @media (prefers-color-scheme: light){ branch whose declarations are only color/background-color; the 13 light group rules equal the implementation-notes strings exactly; the union of light selectors equals the 41 color-bearing selectors extracted from the dark rules with each covered exactly once; every original dark rule statement is still present verbatim; style.css still sets --code-bg: #f6f8fa; and the unrounded WCAG contrast of each of the 13 groups against its applicable background (#f6f8fa, addition #f0fff4, deletion #ffeef0) is at least 4.5:1 and matches the approved spec palette table values, never values derived from this repository's own implementation.
File-local VERSION, CHANGE_SUMMARY and MODULE_CONTRACT/MODULE_MAP of quicklook-runner.test.js are synchronized with the theme-protocol and palette-coverage controls.
